item.title: Lula wins fourth term as Brazil's president in runoff victory
item.description: Brazil's President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has won a historic fourth term in office, defeating far-right challenger Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in a dramatic runoff election. With 51.79% of the vote against Bolsonaro's 48.21%, Lula secured a margin of more than 4 million votes, becoming the first…

item.title: Regional delegations meet in Tehran to defuse Iran-US and Yemen tensions
item.description: High-level security officials from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey—the three signatories of the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement—arrived in Tehran on Monday for talks with Iranian leaders aimed at de-escalating tensions between the United States and Iran and addressing the conflict in Yemen…

item.title: U.S. measles cases double as outbreak spreads; efforts focus on Amish community and importations
item.description: The United States is experiencing its worst measles resurgence in decades, with more than 4,580 cases reported nationally as of Oct. 22, 2026 — more than double the total for all of 2025, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
